ValidationRule.description: For Frequent Flyer Bulk Request, Number of Frequent Flyers has to be more than 15.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND ( RecordType.DeveloperName = "Frequent_Flyer_Request", /*Frequent Flyer Request*/ NOT ( $User.UserRoleId = $Label.QF_Support_QIC_Member), /*QF-Support-Agency Support-QAC*/
Approved__c = FALSE, Number_of_Frequent_Flyer_Request__c < 15 )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: For Bulk Frequent Flyer requests, Number of Frequent Flyers has to be greater than 15.
